terminal.name: Stadsgården Cruise Terminal
terminal.notes: Central Stockholm cruise facility. Multiple adjacent berth numbers share the same general passenger exit zone.

terminals.name: Stadsgården Cruise Terminal
terminals.notes: Central Stockholm cruise facility. Multiple adjacent berth numbers share the same general passenger exit zone.

terminals.name: Nynäshamn Cruise Terminal
terminals.notes: Outer Stockholm-region cruise port used by some large ships. Coordinate marks the passenger terminal and shuttle area.

pois.name: Fotografiska
pois.intro: Fotografiska is an international museum network that presents photography and art. Founded in 2010 in Stockholm, Fotografiska has locations in Stockholm, Tallinn, Berlin, and Shanghai.

pois.name: Den Gyldene Freden
pois.description: Established 1722
pois.intro: Den gyldene freden is a restaurant in the Gamla stan section of Stockholm, Sweden.

pois.name: Avicii Arena
pois.description: Multiarena för musik, sport och evenemang.
pois.intro: Avicii Arena is a multi-purpose arena in Stockholm Globe City, Johanneshov district of Stockholm, Sweden near the Globen metro station. The arena was previously named Stockholm Globe Arena and Ericsson Globe and is referred to in Swedish simply as Globen, as it is shaped like a globe and represents the Sun in the Sweden Solar System, the world's largest scale model of the Solar System.

pois.name: Stockholms slott
pois.intro: Stockholm Palace, or the Royal Palace, is the official residence and major royal palace of the Swedish monarch. Stockholm Palace is in Stadsholmen, in Gamla stan in the capital, Stockholm.

pois.name: Gamla stan
pois.intro: Gamla Stan, until 1980 officially Staden mellan broarna, is the old town of Stockholm, Sweden. Gamla Stan consists primarily of the island Stadsholmen and includes the surrounding islets Riddarholmen, Helgeandsholmen and Strömsborg.

pois.name: Vasamuseet
pois.description: Almost entire 1628 Swedish warship raised and preserved in the '60s.
pois.intro: The Vasa Museum is a maritime museum in Stockholm, Sweden. Located on the island of Djurgården, the museum displays the only almost fully intact 17th-century ship that has ever been salvaged, the 64-gun warship Vasa that sank on her maiden voyage in 1628.

pois.name: Nationalmuseum
pois.description: Sweden's leading museum for art and design.
pois.intro: Nationalmuseum is the national gallery of fine arts of Sweden, located on the peninsula Blasieholmen in central Stockholm. The museum's operations stretch far beyond the borders of Blasieholmen, including the National Portrait Gallery collection at Gripshom, the Gustavsberg porcelain museum, several castle collections and the Swedish Institute in Paris.

pois.name: Skansen
pois.description: Sveriges äldsta friluftsmuseum och Stockholms enda djurpark.
pois.intro: Skansen is the oldest open-air museum and zoo in Sweden located on the island Djurgården in Stockholm, Sweden. It was opened on 11 October 1891 by Artur Hazelius to show the way of life in the different parts of Sweden before the industrial era.

pois.name: Stockholms stadshus
pois.intro: Stockholm City Hall is the seat of Stockholm Municipality in Stockholm, Sweden. It stands on the eastern tip of Kungsholmen island, next to Riddarfjärden's northern shore and facing the islands of Riddarholmen and Södermalm.

pois.name: Nobelprismuseet
pois.description: About the Nobel Prize, Alfred Nobel and the prize winners.
pois.intro: The Nobel Prize Museum is located in the former Stock Exchange Building on the north side of the square Stortorget in Gamla Stan, the old town in central Stockholm, Sweden. The Nobel Prize Museum showcases information about the Nobel Prize and Nobel laureates, as well as information about the founder of the prize, Alfred Nobel.

pois.name: Storkyrkan
pois.intro: Storkyrkan, also called Stockholms domkyrka and Sankt Nikolai kyrka, is the oldest church in Stockholm. Storkyrkan lies in the centre of Stockholm in Gamla stan, between Stockholm Palace and Stortorget, the old main square of Stockholm.

pois.name: Nordiska museet
pois.description: Collection of Swedish cultural objects from 1520 to the present day.
pois.intro: The Nordic Museum is a museum located on Djurgården, an island in central Stockholm, Sweden, dedicated to the cultural history and ethnography of Sweden from the early modern period to the contemporary period. The museum was founded in the late 19th century by Artur Hazelius, who also founded the open-air museum Skansen.

pois.name: Moderna museet
pois.intro: Moderna Museet is a state museum for modern and contemporary art and design, located on the island of Skeppsholmen in central Stockholm, opened in 1958.

pois.name: Riddarholmskyrkan
pois.intro: Riddarholmen Church is the church of the former medieval Greyfriars Monastery in Stockholm, Sweden. The church serves as the final resting place of most Swedish monarchs.

pois.name: Naturhistoriska riksmuseet
pois.description: The universe, animals and nature; and Cosmonova, Sweden's only IMAX cimema
pois.intro: The Swedish Museum of Natural History, in Stockholm, is one of two major museums of natural history in Sweden, the other one being located in Gothenburg. The museum was founded in 1819 by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, but goes back to the collections acquired mostly through donations by the academy since its foundation in 1739.

pois.name: Historiska museet
pois.description: Sweden's history from earliest times to the Middle Ages. Get your Viking fix here.
pois.intro: The Swedish History Museum is a museum located in Stockholm, Sweden, that covers Swedish archaeology and cultural history from the Mesolithic period to present day. Founded in 1866, it operates as a government agency and is tasked with preserving Swedish historical items as well as making knowledge about history available to the public.

pois.name: Haga slott
pois.intro: Haga Palace, formerly known as the Queen's Pavilion, is located in Haga Park, Solna Municipality, in Metropolitan Stockholm, Sweden. The palace is today the residence of Victoria, Crown Princess of Sweden, Prince Daniel, Duke of Västergötland, and their family.

pois.name: Abbamuseet
pois.intro: ABBA The Museum is a Swedish interactive exhibition about the pop band ABBA that opened in Stockholm, Sweden in May 2013. ABBA's collected works are showcased in a contemporary, interactive setting at Djurgården, Stockholm.

pois.name: Hallwylska palatset
pois.description: Private late 19th century palace with Wilhelmina von Hallwyl's collection of Dutch and Flemish painting, porcelain, silver , weapons textiles and household objects.
pois.intro: Hallwyl Museum is a Swedish national museum housed in the historical Hallwyl House in central Stockholm located on 4, Hamngatan facing Berzelii Park. The house once belonged to the Count and Countess von Hallwyl, but was donated to the Swedish state in 1920 to eventually become a museum.

pois.name: Etnografiska museet
pois.description: 220,000 cultural and life style objects from China, Korea, South- and Southeast Asia, The Pacific, the Americas and Africa.
pois.intro: The Museum of Ethnography, in Stockholm, Sweden, is a Swedish science museum. It houses a collection of about 220,000 items relating to the ethnography, or cultural anthropology, of peoples from around the world, including from China, Korea, South and Southeast Asia, the Pacific region, the Americas and Africa.

pois.name: Livrustkammaren
pois.intro: The Royal Armoury is a museum in the Royal Palace in Stockholm, Sweden. It contains many artifacts of Swedish military history and Swedish royalty.

pois.name: Östasiatiska museet
pois.intro: The Museum of Far Eastern Antiquities, located in Stockholm, Sweden, is a museum launched by Sweden's Parliament in 1926, with the Swedish archaeologist Johan Gunnar Andersson as founding director. The museum is located on Skeppsholmen in the building Tyghuset and since 1999 the museum is a part of the public Swedish National Museums of World Culture.

pois.name: Stadsmuseet i Stockholm
pois.description: The development of Stockholm from middle ages fortified port to the city of today.
pois.intro: The Stockholm City Museum is a museum documenting, preserving and exhibiting the history of Stockholm. The museum is housed in Södra Stadshuset at Slussen on Södermalm.

pois.name: Armémuseum
pois.description: Sweden's military museum
pois.intro: The Swedish Army Museum is a museum of military history located in the district of Östermalm in Stockholm. It reopened in 2002 after a long period of closure, and was awarded the title of the best museum of Stockholm in 2005.

pois.name: Operakällaren
pois.intro: Operakällaren is a classic and exclusive restaurant in Kungsträdgården, Stockholm. It is owned through the Nobis corporation by Alessando Catenacci.

pois.name: Kafé 44
pois.intro: Kafé 44 is a café, concert venue, and anarchist bookstore in Stockholm. Based in the Kapsylen work cooperative, which was founded by an artist group in 1976, the café Dagfiket opened in its basement in the early 1980s, and was later followed by the music venue Scen 44 in 1990, and the anarchist bookstore Bokhandeln INFO a few years later.

pois.name: Sturehof
pois.intro: Sturehof is a seafood and shellfish restaurant located on the Stureplan in central Stockholm, Sweden.

pois.name: Vete-Katten
pois.intro: Vete-Katten is a classic Sweden pastry- and coffeeshop.

pois.name: Fem små hus
pois.intro: Fem små hus is a classic restaurant in Gamla stan in central Stockholm, Sweden, located in the Python block in the corner of Nygränd 10 and Österlånggatan 15. The restaurant serves traditional Swedish cuisine with a French influence.

pois.name: AIRA
pois.intro: Aira, stylised as AIRA, is a fine dining restaurant in Stockholm, Sweden. Co-owned by chef Tommy Myllymäki and the Swedish restaurant group Svenska Brasserier, it opened on 17 March 2020.

pois.name: Stadshuskällaren
pois.description: You can order a Nobel Prize dinner menu for any year
pois.intro: Stadshuskällaren är en restaurang i Stockholms stadshus, adress Hantverkargatan 1 på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Stadshuskällaren stod färdig 1922 och är ritad av arkitekt Melchior Wernstedt under överinseende av Ragnar Östberg.

pois.name: Kvarnen
pois.intro: Kvarnen är en restaurang och tillika ölhall med gamla traditioner. Den ligger på Tjärhovsgatan mitt på Södermalm i Stockholm och invigdes år 1908 som ett av Stockholms utskänkningsaktiebolags värdshus.

pois.name: Pelikan
pois.intro: Restaurang Pelikan ligger sedan 1969 på Blekingegatan 40 på Södermalm i Stockholm. Tidigare låg Pelikan både i Gamla stan och vid Brunnsbacken.

pois.name: Grand Palace
pois.description: really big and really chinese

pois.name: Matbaren
pois.intro: Mathias Dahlgren var en exklusiv restaurang som öppnades 2007 av stjärnkocken med samma namn, Mathias Dahlgren, belägen i Grand Hôtel i Stockholm, i Bolinderska palatsets bottenvåning. Restaurangen bestod av två delar: Matsalen, som var den exklusivare delen, och Matbaren med något enklare utförande.

pois.name: Den Gröne Jägaren
pois.intro: Den gröne Jägaren is a bar and restaurant at Götgatan 64 in Södermalm, Stockholm, Sweden.

pois.name: Tudor Arms
pois.intro: Tudor Arms är en engelsk pub belägen på Grevgatan 31 på Östermalm i Stockholm, öppnad i oktober 1969. Puben utnämndes till världens bästa pub utanför England av The Telegraph i maj 2010.

pois.name: Kupan
pois.description: Cheap! Coffee and Tea

pois.name: Drop Coffee Roasters
pois.description: Speciality coffee shop and café serving coffee cup by cup from their own roasters. Pour-over and espresso with a wide selection of coffee to choose from.

pois.name: Nordiska Kompaniet
pois.intro: Nordiska Kompaniet is the name of two luxury department stores located in Stockholm and Gothenburg, in Sweden. The store in Stockholm receives some twelve million visitors annually, with the figure for the store in Gothenburg being about three million and the total number of staff around 1,200.

pois.name: Hötorgshallen
pois.intro: Hötorgshalle, schwedisch Hötorgshallen, ist eine Markthalle am Hötorget im Zentrum von Stockholm.

pois.name: PUB
pois.intro: PUB was one of the major department stores in Stockholm, Sweden, located in two buildings at Hötorget, Stockholm city center. PUB was opened in 1882 and rapidly expanded.

pois.name: Pet Sounds
pois.description: Vinyl & CD

pois.name: Gateau
pois.intro: Gateau är ett svenskt livsmedelsföretag med inriktning på bröd och bakverk, numera ägt av Fazer. Gateau har ett bageri i Slakthusområdet i Stockholm och ett i Lund.

pois.name: Nacka Forum
pois.intro: För jazzbandet, se Nacka Forum. Nacka Forum är ett köpcentrum i Nacka kommun, Stockholms län.

pois.name: Söderhallarna
pois.intro: Die Södermalmshalle ist eine Markthalle im Stadtteil Södermalm in Stockholm. Die Södermalmshalle bildet die westliche Begrenzung des Medborgarplatsen.

pois.name: Androuet
pois.description: French cheese

pois.name: Kungsträdgården
pois.intro: Kungsträdgården is a park in central Stockholm, Sweden. It is colloquially known as Kungsan.

pois.name: Katarinahissen
pois.intro: The Katarina Elevator or Katarina Lift is a passenger elevator in Stockholm that connects Slussen to the heights of Södermalm. The lift was a shortcut between Katarinavägen, Slussen and Mosebacke torg.

pois.name: Mariatorget
pois.intro: Mariatorget is a square and a city park in the district of Södermalm in Stockholm, Sweden.

pois.name: Humlegården
pois.intro: Humlegården is a major park in the district of Östermalm in Stockholm, Sweden. The park borders on Karlavägen in the north, Sturegatan in the east, Humlegårdsgatan in the south and Engelbrektsgatan in the west.

pois.name: Bergianska trädgården
pois.intro: The Bergianska trädgården, the Bergian Garden or Hortus Bergianus, is a botanical garden located in the Frescati area on the outskirts of Stockholm, close to the Swedish Museum of Natural History and the main campus of Stockholm University. The director of the garden is known as Professor Bergianus.

pois.name: Karlaplan
pois.intro: Karlaplan is an open park-plaza area in Östermalm in central Stockholm, Sweden.

pois.name: Åsöberget
pois.intro: Åsöberget är ett berg och ett område belägen i stadsdelen Södermalm i Stockholm. Här finns, tillsammans med Djurgårdsstaden, den mest omfattande och sammanhängande trähusbebyggelsen i Stockholm.

pois.name: Hammarbytoppen
pois.intro: Hammarbybacken är en till största delen konstgjord kulle i stadsdelen Björkhagen i södra Stockholm. En hoppbacke invigdes redan 1919 och en alpin skidanläggning öppnade 1990.

pois.name: Koloniträdgård
pois.intro: Skansens koloniträdgård är en koloniträdgård som finns på Skansen i Stockholm. Koloniträdgården består av två lotter med var sin tidstypiska stuga.

pois.name: Skinnarviksberget
pois.intro: Skinnarviksberget är ett bergsparti på Södermalm i Stockholm och en del av Skinnarviksparken. Med sina 53 meter över havet är berget den högsta naturliga punkten innanför tullarna och bjuder på en grandios utsikt över Riddarfjärden och Kungsholmen.

pois.name: Skyview
pois.intro: Avicii Arena is a multi-purpose arena in Stockholm Globe City, Johanneshov district of Stockholm, Sweden near the Globen metro station. The arena was previously named Stockholm Globe Arena and Ericsson Globe and is referred to in Swedish simply as Globen, as it is shaped like a globe and represents the Sun in the Sweden Solar System, the world's largest scale model of the Solar System.

pois.name: Liljevalchs konsthall
pois.description: Art gallery with a goal to make art more accessible to all, focus is contemporary art.
pois.intro: Liljevalchs konsthall is a kunsthalle art venue located on Djurgården island in Stockholm, Sweden. Designed by architect Carl Bergsten and inaugurated in March 1916, it is today owned by the City of Stockholm.

pois.name: Gröna Lund
pois.intro: Gröna Lund, or colloquially Grönan, is an amusement park in Stockholm, Sweden. Located on the seaward side of Djurgården, it is 3.8 ha in size, relatively small compared to other amusement parks, mainly because of its central location, which limits expansion.

pois.name: Tyska kyrkan
pois.intro: The German Church, sometimes called St. Gertrude's Church, is a church in Gamla stan, the old town in central Stockholm, Sweden, belonging to the German Saint Gertrude Parish of the Church of Sweden.

pois.name: Sagerska huset
pois.description: Official residence of Swedish prime minister
pois.intro: The Sager House or Sager Palace is the official residence of the prime minister of Sweden, located at Strömgatan 18 in central Stockholm.

pois.name: Tessinska palatset
pois.intro: The Tessin Palace is a baroque town house located in Gamla stan, the old town in central Stockholm. Located next to the Royal Palace, it is facing Slottsbacken, the major approach to the Stockholm Palace, and flanked by two alleys, Finska kyrkogränd and Bollhusgränd.

pois.name: Klara kyrka
pois.intro: The Church of Saint Clare or Klara Church is a church in central Stockholm. A church has been at the site since the 1280s; the current buildings date from the sixteenth through nineteenth centuries.

pois.name: Vita bergen
pois.intro: Vita Bergen is a park area of Södermalm in Stockholm.

pois.name: PK-huset
pois.intro: PK-huset is a combined office and department store building at Hamngatan and Norrlandsgatan at Norrmalm in Stockholm. Nowadays, the Nordic finance group Nordea has its Swedish branch office in the building.

terminalResolution.notes: Stadsgarden, Frihamnen, and Nynashamn (a gateway port 47 km south) are all used by cruise ships. Added Masthamnen next to Stadsgarden and moved the Frihamnen pin about 750 m onto the Cruise Center (from Google Maps).
